explication: CRMEB is a multi-channel PHP e-commerce platform: shoppers browse products, manage carts, place and pay for orders, and use account and promotion features; merchants operate the store through an admin API. The README also documents marketing, DIY themes, content, live commerce, and integrations across web, mobile, and WeChat channels. The tree shows separate API, admin, and data-access areas. Source excerpts confirm the brokerage controller-to-service flow and the admin storage-management flow; other subsystem wiring is represented only where supported by the tree or README.
